subject: Your dental clinic website needs these fixes
body:
Hi there,

I was reviewing 16 Mile Dental's website and noticed 5 SEO issues that are likely costing you traffic:

1. Title too long (310 chars, may be truncated in SERP)
2. Meta description too long (522 chars)
3. No Schema markup (JSON-LD)

Rank Ray offers a free detailed audit to show you exactly what to fix.

I can send you a free detailed SEO report with step-by-step fixes.

Cheers,
Sheikh from Rank Ray
https://rankray.com
